Both Pachyelaside-A and Benzofuran are known to interact with Methionine aminopeptidase 2, indicating a possible pathway through which (+)-Actinidine may influence this enzyme. The scores from the three paths suggest a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, with the highest score from path_136713. The evidence is consistent across different compounds, suggesting a possible mechanism involving the inhibition or modulation of Methionine aminopeptidase 2 through the targeting of its upstream regulators. However, the exact nature of the interaction remains uncertain, and further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the direct effect of (+)-Actinidine on the enzyme.
